title: Support navigation in multi-page web views

statement.en: When people are likely to visit multiple pages in a web view, support forward and back navigation.
statement.ja: web viewで複数pageを訪れる可能性が高い場合はforwardとback navigationをsupportする。

conditions: Provide controls that initiate forward and back navigation because the behavior isn't available by default.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Web views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるWeb viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “When people are likely to visit multiple pages in a web view, support forward and back navigation.” in the documented Web views context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: When people are likely to visit multiple pages in a web view, support forward and back navigation.

apple_native_rule: When people are likely to visit multiple pages in a web view, support forward and back navigation.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Avoid recreating a web browser with a web view

statement.en: Avoid using a web view to recreate Safari-style web-browsing functionality.
statement.ja: Safariのようなweb browsing機能を再現するためにweb viewを使わない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.
exceptions: Briefly presenting a website without making people leave the app context is acceptable.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Web views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Avoid web views on tvOS and watchOS

statement.en: Avoid using web views on tvOS or watchOS because the component isn't supported there.
statement.ja: componentがsupportされないためtvOSまたはwatchOSでweb viewを使わない。

conditions: There are no additional Web views considerations for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or visionOS.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Web views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
